_comment: Items tools/Get-Inventory.ps1 found that FocusedTweaks leaves alone on purpose, with the reason. Names may hold wildcards. Anything here stops being reported as unknown. First filled from the Windows 11 x64 VM inventory of 14 Nov 2026.

services.RpcSs: core: Remote Procedure Call, everything depends on it
services.DcomLaunch: core: starts COM and DCOM servers
services.KeyIso: core: key isolation for certificates and sign in
services.UserManager: core: user sessions, Start and taskbar need it
services.gpsvc: core: applies policies, the policy options of this script need it
services.EventLog: core: event log, the health check and Windows need it
services.EventSystem: core: COM+ events, many components need it
services.SystemEventsBroker: core: system events for apps and tasks
services.Themes: core: desktop theme and visual styles
services.FontCache: speed: font cache, disabling it slows every app start
services.Schedule: core: Task Scheduler, the time sync and Defender tasks need it
services.StateRepository: core: app state, Start and Store apps need it
services.Winmgmt: core: WMI, this script and many tools need it
services.CryptSvc: core: certificates and signatures, updates need it
services.AppIDSvc: security: application identity for AppLocker and Smart App Control
services.camsvc: privacy: grants and denies camera, microphone and location access
services.netprofm: network: network list, the network icon needs it
services.WinHttpAutoProxySvc: network: proxy detection, apps use WinHTTP
services.BFE: security: firewall and IPsec filtering engine
services.BITS: updates: background transfers for Windows Update and the Store
services.UsoSvc: updates: managed by the PauseUpdates options, not disabled
services.wuauserv: updates: managed by the PauseUpdates options, not disabled
services.TrustedInstaller: updates: Windows servicing, runs only while it installs
services.AppXSvc: Store: installs and updates apps, the Store is kept
services.ClipSVC: Store: app licences, the Store is kept
services.InstallService: Store: app installs, the Store is kept
services.LicenseManager: Store: app licences, the Store is kept
services.wlidsvc: Store: Microsoft account sign in for the Store and Xbox
services.TokenBroker: Store: web account sign in for apps
services.StorSvc: storage: drives and Store app storage
services.BDESVC: security: BitLocker; NoDeviceEncryption decides automatic encryption
services.MDCoreSvc: security: Defender core service, the -Defender parameter decides
services.WdNisSvc: security: Defender network inspection, the -Defender parameter decides
services.edgeupdate: browser: Edge and WebView2 updates, kept on purpose with the updater tasks
services.UdkUserSvc: shell: Start, taskbar and Windows UI components
services.NPSMSvc: shell: media controls and the volume overlay
services.lmhosts: network: NetBIOS name resolution; disabling can break finding PCs and shares at home, for no real gain
services.MSDTC: on demand: database transactions, starts only when a program asks for it
services.PushToInstall: Store: on demand, installs apps sent from the Store website; the Store is kept

apps.Microsoft.ApplicationCompatibilityEnhanc: system: app compatibility fixes delivered through the Store
apps.Microsoft.Winget.Source: system: winget's package source, the Packages option uses winget

features.MediaPlayback: media: needed for audio and video playback
features.Printing-Foundation-Features: printing: print support (SvcPrinting decides the spooler)
features.SearchEngine-Client-Package: search: Start and Explorer search; SearchIndexingOff stops the indexer
features.SmbDirect: network: file sharing over RDMA network cards, costs nothing without that hardware
